title: Strict log-concavity in the first type-B q-Stirling column
summary: For k = 1 and n ≥ 2, every interior coefficient gap is strictly positive exactly when n ≥ 6. At n = 5, equality occurs only at degree 1.
verification: Lean proof for all n. Python replay through 256 rows.

title: A 19-vertex counterexample to Graffiti.pc Conjecture 138
summary: A tree has a longest induced path on 17 vertices. Its unique maximum independent set and the distance between the square graph’s two maximum-degree vertices give a conjectured lower bound of 18. The construction extends to an infinite family.
verification: Direct proof for the family and exhaustive Python verification of the 19-vertex witness. External review and priority remain open.

title: A proof of Graffiti.pc 392b on 2-domination and matchings
summary: Proves the proposed upper bound for the 2-domination number of every finite simple connected graph with more than two vertices, including graphs with leaves.
verification: Five Lean modules and a final theorem checked by the Lean kernel. No earlier full resolution was found in the literature search. Priority remains undetermined.
subject: Graph theory
keywords: Graffiti.pc, Written on the Wall II, 392b, 2-domination, matchings, Ermelinda DeLaViña

title: One-sided log-concavity for a column of the type B q-Stirling numbers
summary: Proves the parity inequality on the rising side of first-kind column one at every rank, and on the second diagonal of both families. The unrestricted conjecture remains open.
verification: Eight Lean modules, with final recurrence theorems checked against a three-axiom allowlist.
subject: Algebraic combinatorics
keywords: Sagan, Swanson, type B, q-Stirling numbers, log-concavity, unimodality

title: Coefficient inequalities for the type B q-Stirling numbers
summary: A combined technical note on seven Lean-verified results. Strict adjacent log-concavity in second-kind column one begins at rank six for ranks at least two. The note also proves a rising-side inequality in first-kind column one and parity log-concavity on the second diagonal of both families.
verification: Seven final declarations across eight proof modules replayed with a three-axiom allowlist.
subject: Algebraic combinatorics
keywords: Sagan, Swanson, type B, q-Stirling numbers, log-concavity, unimodality

title: Two partial results on the Seacrest–Seacrest graph-grabbing conjecture
summary: On even connected bipartite graphs with no induced once-subdivided claw, Alice can secure half the weight if adjacent positive weights agree. A second result compares opposite choices of the last vertex on a path with attached leaves. The general conjecture remains open.
verification: Three final theorems checked in Lean 4.37.0-rc1 with an axiom audit.
subject: Graph theory
keywords: Seacrest, graph grabbing, bipartite graphs, rooted game, claw, weighted graphs

title: A counterexample to Songsuwan’s period-two conjecture for Node-Kayles
summary: On a fixed 291-vertex graph, attach copies of the same five-vertex path at one vertex. The Node-Kayles values are 8 and 9 at arbitrarily large branch counts two apart. This disproves Songsuwan’s Conjecture 2.
verification: Lean 4.37.0-rc1 checks the exact game values and failure of eventual period two. An independent Python evaluator checks all 2,176 certificate entries.
subject: Combinatorial game theory
keywords: Node-Kayles, Sprague-Grundy value, graph games, periodicity, Songsuwan

title: A uniform lower bound on the transient length of the consecutive-231 stack map
summary: For every n ≥ 8, some permutation of length n takes at least n + 3 passes of the consecutive-231 stack map to reach a periodic point.
verification: Lean checks the construction for every n ≥ 8 and every pass before n + 3.
subject: Enumerative combinatorics
keywords: stack sorting, consecutive pattern, Seidel, Sun, Yi, transient length
